g.text: Exact viologen on an open five-repeat polymer model
Same handle positions (2, 3, 4); only occupied sites change. Two grafts give bare charge +4.
Teal: open carbon backbone · Orange: viologen cores · Purple: residual benzyl chloride
Numbers label repeat sites. Terminal repeats 1 and 5 are unfunctionalized styrene padding.
Connectivity drawings; prepared XYZ structures are audited separately. No interaction energy is shown.
Counterions are omitted from coordinates. PF₆⁻ appears only in a separate dry-salt mass convention.
